messages:
Alex Chen: FYI Meridian flagged a spike in p99 token latency on Dedicated. They've asked for a fix within 48h, pushing for a hotfix. Details: customer-id MID-881, region eu-west-1. Need decision: hotfix vs next scheduled patch. Thoughts?
Maya Patel: Do we have a replay/log link? Is this regression after last runtime change?
Alex Chen: Link: https://logs.redwood/meridian/trace/abc123
Jorge Rivera: Looking at logs — lots of small bursts hitting large seq lengths, KV cache miss rate up. Could be batching config + routing. No obvious kernel crash.
Sarah Li: If it's config, we can revert batching/striped-batcher change. Reverting is low-risk. Hotfix timeline: 2-4h to test canary, 6-8h to full rollout.
Evan Gupta: Meridian is asking for an explicit comms plan and an ETA. They won't accept "next release" in 2 weeks.
Maya Patel: Proposal: start a 10% canary to their Dedicated pool + route fallback to hosted for high-seq requests. If metrics look good after 30m, promote. If not, roll back.
Jorge Rivera: Agreed. Canary config:
```
rollout: canary
target: dedicated-meridian
percent: 10
metric: p99_latency_ms
threshold: 200
window: 30m
```
Sarah Li: Also add temporary routing policy: requests with seq_len>1024 -> hosted-compat model. Quick to flip.
Alex Chen: Meridian accepts canary if we provide SLA credit if it fails. Legal pre-approved credit? :thinking_face:
Maya Patel: We can offer a 10% usage credit as a gesture, pending postmortem.
Evan Gupta: I'll draft customer message. Key points: canary start time, expected impact, fallback, contact. Want to send within 1h.
deploy-bot: Started canary rollout to dedicated-meridian (10%) — ID rollout_1956781234 — monitoring p99.
Jorge Rivera: Initial telemetry: first 10m stable, p99 dropped from 290 -> 180 for canary. KV miss still slightly higher.
Sarah Li: Keep canary 60m, run synthetic high-seq tests, if no regressions promote.
Alex Chen: Meridian wants 24h confirmation before we schedule full rollout. Can we commit to 24h from canary start?
Maya Patel: Yes, target: canary now, promote within 24h if green. If not green, rollback and schedule full investigation with customer.
Evan Gupta: Messaging ready, I'll post after we see 30m green. cc @Legal @SupportTeam
Maya Patel: I'll update the backlog: create ticket PROD-6221 "Meridian dedicated p99 spike — canary rollout & followup". Assign to Eng-Platform.
Jorge Rivera: Acknowledged. I'll own the canary and rollback steps.
Alex Chen: Thanks all. I'll update Meridian and set expectation.
deploy-bot: Canary reached 30m stable. rollout_1956781234 status: healthy. Monitoring continue.
Evan Gupta: Sending message now. Thanks team :thumbsup:
